description: scripts/generate-copilot-artifacts.mjs copies skills/*/SKILL.md verbatim into dist/copilot/ without applying the Ralph generator's substitution rules. The plan states the generator should 'adapt the Ralph plugin's transformation rules but change discovery'. As a result, mirrors such as dist/copilot/work-on/SKILL.md:180 still contain Claude-specific Skill(...) invocations like Skill("ralph-orchestration:implement-with-ralph", args="resume my-job") that would be invalid under Copilot. AC14 (mirror count parity) still passes because it only counts files, not content adaptation.
suggestedFix: Pipe each SKILL.md through an applySubstitutions() helper modeled on plugins/ralph/scripts/generate-copilot-artifacts.mjs SUBSTITUTIONS array (skill-dispatch, agent-dispatch, options-tags, mcp-tools, etc.). At minimum, the substitutions safe for ralph-overview mirrors are the ones that rewrite Skill(...) and Agent(...) into Copilot task() calls.
